integrity: The proof uses the published normalization and cusp types plus an exact cross-ratio argument. The packaged checker independently replays the algebraic weight and cross-ratio computations.
scientific_limitations: The statement is specific to the Koras--Palka extremal four-cuspidal plane quintic over \(\mathbb C\). Historical literature could contain an unindexed symmetry observation; the body of Field's 1924 paper was not available in the inspected text interface.
title: The extremal four-cuspidal quintic has projective automorphism group \(C_3\)
